You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered passages given.

Rules:
- Use only these passages. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the passages do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the passages.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several passages answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [passage numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Can model CS-400 stay with internal production control after 20 January 2027?

Passages:
[0] eu-dir-2014-35, Annex III: ANNEX III MODULE A Internal production control 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the electrical equipment concerned satisfy the requirements of this Directive that apply to it.

[1] eu-dir-2014-30, Annex II: ANNEX II MODULE A: INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3, 4 and 5 of this Annex, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the apparatus concerned satisfy the requirements of this Directive that apply to it.

[2] eu-dir-2010-75, Art. 34(1): Article 34 Small isolated systems. 1. Until 31 December 2019, combustion plants being, on 6 January 2011, part of a small isolated system may be exempted from compliance with the emission limit values referred to in Article 30(2) and the rates of desulphurisation referred to in Article 31, where applicable. Until 31 December 2019, the emission limit values set out in the permits of these combustion plants, pursuant in particular to the requirements of Directives 2001/80/EC and 2008/1/EC, shall at least be maintained.

[3] eu-reg-2016-425, Annex IV: ANNEX IV INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL (Module A) 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the PPE concerned satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

[4] eu-dir-2014-68, Annex III, 4: 4. MODULE C2: CONFORMITY TO TYPE BASED ON INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL PLUS SUPERVISED PRESSURE EQUIPMENT CHECKS AT RANDOM INTERVALS 1. Conformity to type based on internal production control plus supervised pressure equipment checks at random intervals is the part of a conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the pressure equipment concerned is in conformity with the type described in the EU-type examination certificate and satisfy the requirements of this Directive that apply to it.

[5] eu-dir-2014-68, Annex III, 1: 1. MODULE A: (INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL) 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the pressure equipment concerned satisfy the requirements of this Directive.

[6] REG, Annex VIII: ANNEX VIII CONFORMITY TO TYPE BASED ON INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL (Module C) 1. Conformity to type based on internal production control is the part of a conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2 and 3, and ensures and declares under its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned is in conformity with the type described in the EU type-examination certificate and satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

[7] REG, Annex VI: ANNEX VI INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL (Module A) 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

[8] eu-reg-2016-425, Annex VII: ANNEX VII CONFORMITY TO TYPE BASED ON INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL PLUS SUPERVISED PRODUCT CHECKS AT RANDOM INTERVALS (Module C2) 1. Conformity to type based on internal production control plus supervised product checks at random intervals is the part of a conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3, 5.2 and 6, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the PPE, which has been subject to the provisions of point 4, is in conformity with the type described in the EU type-examination certificate and satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

[9] eu-reg-2016-425, Annex VI: ANNEX VI CONFORMITY TO TYPE BASED ON INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL (Module C) 1. Conformity to type based on internal production control is the part of a conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2 and 3, and ensures and declares under his sole responsibility that the PPE concerned is in conformity with the type described in the EU type-examination certificate and satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.
